summary: Iteration 36: Geo Location Form Testing - Custom distance field and IBGE State/City integration. Backend calcular_pontos_povao() working correctly (100% pass). IBGE API integration verified via direct API tests (3/3 pass) and frontend UI testing. State/City dropdowns cascade properly - selecting a state loads cities from IBGE API.

issues: Point values displayed incorrectly for Ranking do Povão: shows '10-20km = 7pts' and '21km+ = 9pts' but backend calculates '10-20km = 10pts' and '21km+ = distance in pts'. This is inconsistent with SubmeterResultadoPage.js which shows correct values.
Regulamento text (linha 939) also shows incorrect values: '10km a 20km = 7pts, 21km ou mais = 9pts'
design_issues.fix_required: Update CadastroPage.js lines 759-761 and line 939 to match backend logic: 10-20km = 10pts, 21km+ = distância em pts
